verdict.rationale: HMRC runs a live production REST API platform (hello/world returns a structured header/auth error), so issuing scoped API credentials is a fair question for this product. However, nothing in the pack documents how API credentials are issued, scoped, or restricted for a software or AI agent. The 'agent' sign-up path refers to human tax agents acting for clients, not least-privilege API credentials. The developer hub docs were not fetched because robots.txt blocks crawlers.
